Hi Emily — appreciated. Nov 16/17 look good on our side; we can do a pre-brief the week prior (90 minutes) to align infra and scoping.

Draft agenda for the two-day immersion (please comment):
Day 1 (Nov 16) — Technical deep dive & hands-on- 09:00 intro + objectives- 09:30 architecture walkthrough (runtime, caching, routing)- 11:00 lab 1: provisioning sandbox + model pinning- 14:00 lab 2: KV cache strategies + performance tuning- 16:00 breakout: partner-specific use case mapping
Day 2 (Nov 17) — Ops and handoff- 09:00 runbook authoring exercise- 11:00 CI/CD snippet & deployment checklist- 14:00 incident & fallback simulation- 15:30 rollout planning + Q&A

Prework request for Catalyst engineers (short): 1) confirm sandbox account requests, 2) share a short list of 3 sample payloads, 3) send attendee names and roles.

I'll loop in Marissa for enablement materials and Laura for partnership ops. Could Laura or Marissa confirm capacity on those dates?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference

- Nov 2: Sandbox VPC peering doc first draft (Vivek)
- Nov 5: Runbook template + sample CI snippet (Marissa + Aditya)

- Nov 9: SRE 30-min sync with Catalyst (Jonas schedule)

I've attached a short prework checklist that we'll send to Catalyst after Vivek confirms the VPC instructions. Please reply-all with any blockers by EOD Tue Nov 2.
